name: Scribendo HQ Connector
author: ascentdigitalllc

sections.description:
Scribendo HQ™ goes beyond basic AI writing by combining advanced marketing logic, audience-focused heuristics, and conversion-driven workflows at every stage of content creation. Instead of producing generic copy, it creates strategically structured landing pages, blog articles, and product content designed to build stronger audience connections, communicate benefits clearly, and inspire action. The result is more relevant, engaging, and sales-focused content without the time, expense, or complexity of coordinating multiple tools and marketing specialists.

AI content writing built around your audience

Turn your topics, product benefits, and content guidance into marketing copy for your WordPress website. Choose your audience, tone, and language to guide generation, then review and refine the results before publishing. Scribendo HQ brings blog writing, landing-page copy, and WooCommerce product descriptions into one connected workflow.

Blog articles: build a useful content library

Create or rewrite SEO-focused blog posts with structured headings, relevant images, and internal links to related articles in the same category when suitable content is available. Save time preparing drafts, and schedule blog draft creation for your editorial review rather than automatic publication.

Landing pages: lead with the reasons to buy

Generate benefit-led landing-page content that puts the main value proposition first, followed by supporting details and calls to action. Use your brief, audience priorities, and brand guidance to shape copy and images for the offer you want to promote.

WooCommerce product descriptions: explain value clearly

Use Scribendo HQ AI Product Updater for WooCommerce to create or rewrite short and long product descriptions, product features, SEO titles, and meta descriptions. Work with new or existing products, provide product facts and benefits, and choose whether to keep existing images or request product-image processing. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this feature.

Connected service and technical overview

Scribendo HQ Connector connects an authorized WordPress administrator’s website to the Scribendo HQ hosted content-generation service.

The connector provides separate workflows for:

  • AI-assisted blog article creation and rewriting.
  • AI-assisted landing-page content creation and rewriting.
  • Scribendo HQ AI Product Updater for WooCommerce, including AI-assisted product content and product-image processing when WooCommerce is active.
  • Scheduled blog generation as drafts for administrator review.

An active Scribendo HQ tenant account and subscription are required. The content-generation service is not included in the plugin and is not performed locally by WordPress.

External service disclosure

Scribendo HQ Connector is a client for the Scribendo HQ hosted content-generation service. Its core purpose is to send administrator-requested content or image-generation jobs to the Scribendo HQ SaaS Platform and return the results to the connected WordPress site. A Scribendo HQ tenant account and active subscription are required. Accounts are available at https://scribo.scribendohq.ai/sign-up and can be managed at https://scribo.scribendohq.ai/tenant-login.

The default service host is https://scribo.scribendohq.ai/. Depending on the requested operation, the plugin communicates with these service endpoints:

  • /api/aiblog/v1/validate-connector to validate the Tenant ID, Internal API ID, account status, plan limits, and connector configuration.
  • /api/aiblog/v1/generate-content to generate or rewrite requested blog, landing-page, or WooCommerce product copy.
  • /api/aiblog/v1/generate-images to generate requested blog and landing-page images.
  • /api/aiblog/v1/generate-product-image to process a requested WooCommerce product image.

The plugin contacts the service only after an authorized administrator enters the Scribendo HQ platform URL, Tenant ID, and Internal API ID, tests the connection, manually requests generation, or configures scheduled draft creation.

Depending on the requested operation, the connector may send:

  • Tenant ID and Internal API ID for authentication.
  • The website domain and ordinary network metadata, including the server IP address, for connection security and abuse auditing.
  • Administrator-entered topics, titles, briefs, benefits, product details, audience selections, tone, language, image instructions, and CTA settings.
  • Selected WordPress post, page, category, or WooCommerce product context needed to create or rewrite content.
  • Product image URLs or uploaded product-image data when product-image processing is requested.
  • Local monthly usage counts so tenant plan limits can be enforced.

Generated content and image data are returned through the service API and stored in WordPress posts or the local Media Library. Generated images are not hotlinked from Scribendo HQ or another image provider. The plugin does not load remote advertising, analytics, fonts, JavaScript, CSS, decorative images, or placeholder images. Sign Up, Account, Support, service-information, privacy-policy, and terms-of-service URLs are ordinary administrator-facing links and are not embedded remote assets.

Service information: https://scribo.scribendohq.ai/

Privacy policy: https://scribo.scribendohq.ai/privacy-policy

Terms of service: https://scribo.scribendohq.ai/terms-of-service

Contributors

  • Scribendo HQ
  • Ascent Digital LLC

Privacy

The plugin adds suggested Scribendo HQ disclosure text to WordPress Settings > Privacy. Site owners remain responsible for reviewing that text and accurately describing their own configuration and use of generated content.

The connector does not add visitor tracking. API security logs maintained by the Scribendo HQ service may include the tenant identifier, website domain, server IP address, endpoint, request time, and request-volume information.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directory to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Scribendo HQ Connector.
  3. Open Scribendo HQ > Connection.
  4. Enter the SaaS Platform URL, Tenant ID, and Internal API ID supplied with your Scribendo HQ tenant account.
  5. Save the settings and use Test Connection before requesting content generation.
  6. Install and activate WooCommerce only if the Scribendo HQ AI Product Updater for WooCommerce is needed.
sections.faq:
Is a Scribendo HQ account required?

Yes. The plugin is a connector for the Scribendo HQ hosted service and requires an active tenant account.

Does the plugin send data to an external service?

Yes. It sends the authentication and content context described in the External service disclosure when an administrator requests generation or enables scheduling.

Is WooCommerce required for the Scribendo HQ AI Product Updater for WooCommerce?

WooCommerce is required only for the Scribendo HQ AI Product Updater for WooCommerce. Blog and landing-page features remain available without it.

Does the plugin automatically publish content?

No. Generated blog and landing-page content is saved as a draft so an authorized WordPress user can review it and take responsibility for publishing it.

Where are generated images stored?

Returned images are validated, optimized, and stored in the WordPress Media Library.
sections.changelog:
50.0.157

  • Centered primary and secondary landing-page CTA messages and buttons.
  • Added installed-theme template selection and page-scoped display preferences for landing pages.
  • Added configurable selectors for page title, masthead bottom margin, and search display overrides.

50.0.156

  • Updated the Service information URL to the Scribendo HQ SaaS Platform domain.

50.0.155

  • Updated the Terms of Service URL to the Scribendo HQ SaaS Platform domain.
  • Added Ascent Digital LLC to the visible contributors list while retaining the valid WordPress.org contributor username header.

50.0.154

  • Removed the remote Picsum placeholder image from the quota-exempt connection-test draft.
  • Clarified the Scribendo HQ hosted service, required account, API endpoints, transmitted data, and local storage of returned images.
  • Confirmed that plugin JavaScript, CSS, and decorative assets are bundled locally.

50.0.153

  • Updated readme feature descriptions to use the Scribendo HQ AI Product Updater for WooCommerce product name.

50.0.152

  • Moved plugin JavaScript and CSS loading to WordPress enqueue APIs.
  • Replaced direct script and style tag output with registered assets, localized data, and WordPress inline asset helpers.
  • Updated the Scribendo HQ privacy-policy URL in the external-service disclosure.

Earlier release notes are available in changelog.txt included with the plugin.
